title: Fix generated docs casing drift
summary: Normalized active generated documentation paths from Docs to docs, hardened summary generation against future Docs/docs casing drift, refreshed generated context, and refreshed the WebView godfile split map.
reason: Deep Audit was failing generated-context and WebView map checks because generated summaries and navigation artifacts still referenced the historical uppercase Docs path on a Windows checkout.
behavior_before: Generated summaries could remain under docs/generated/summaries/Docs and summary checks reported missing or mismatched docs sources after the working tree used lowercase docs paths. The WebView godfile split map was also stale.
behavior_after: The summary generator canonicalizes any Docs path spelling to docs, active docs summaries are stored under docs/generated/summaries/docs, generated navigation files are refreshed, and the WebView map check passes.
manual_validation: WARN: npm run webview:prework:check failed at the lint-budget gate because existing WebView warning counts exceed the baseline: complexity 115 > 108, max-lines-per-function 46 > 37, no-extra-boolean-cast 1 > 0, no-unused-vars 192 > 143. This scoped change did not update the lint budget.
rollback_plan: Revert the refresh_summaries.py canonicalization and regression test, restore the generated docs summary paths/artifacts from the previous commit, then rerun refresh_summaries --check and webview:map:check.
notes:
Normalize documentation tree casing and regenerated generated documentation artifacts.
Use existing WebView map scripts for generated map validation.
Track the generated context and WebView map drift fix.
Canonicalize docs path casing when generating and validating summaries.
Regenerate generated context after summary casing cleanup.
Refresh WebView split map so WebView prework map check is current.
Add regression coverage for docs path casing canonicalization.
Regenerate dependency graph after summary inventory refresh.
Regenerate feature map after project index refresh.
Rename active docs summaries to lowercase docs path and refresh stale generated summaries.
